newsitem.title: UK: Merrill upgrades Russian equities to overweight.
newsitem.headline: Merrill upgrades Russian equities to overweight.

text.p: Merrill Lynch has upgraded the Russian equity market to "overweight" as it believes the positive investment ratings from credit rating agencies will feed through to investor confidence in the equity market. "With Standard & Poors rating at BB- and its Moody's rating at Ba2, we believe that the market is set for further appreciation," Merrill First Vice President Dan Lubash said.
On Wednesday, share turnover on the Russian Trading System hit a record high volume of $46.97 million.
Merrill believes that economic growth of 0.5 to 1.0 percent in 1996 will rise to 2.0 to 3.0 percent in 1997 as strong oil prices feed through to support the economy.
There is also room for the rouble to appreciate by 10-15 percent in the remainder of this year and 1997.
Merrill picks telecommunications and oil companies as prime beneficiaries.
